title: Chroma Input Parameters
description: Chroma-specific parameters passed via DesignRequest.toolParams. Chroma is a programmable generative model that emits protein backbones (sequences come from downstream ProteinMPNN; see manifest.composes). Supports unconditional de novo generation when no target PDB is provided.

length.description: Target residue length for the generated backbone. Ignored when `length_range` is set.

length_range.description: Alternative to `length`: inclusive [min, max] range from which per-design lengths are sampled.

num_designs.description: Backbones per seed. Mirrored at top-level DesignRequest.numDesigns.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the diffusion / conditioner guidance step.

steps.description: Number of diffusion steps. Upstream default is 500; lower for speed, higher for quality.

conditioners.description: Ordered list of Chroma conditioners (substructure, symmetry, shape, classifier, subsequence, procap, etc.). The adapter instantiates these against chroma.layers.structure.conditioners when it executes. The full conditioner union is upstream-driven and intentionally open-ended here — TODO: lock down the conditioner type union once upstream stabilizes its schema.

type.description: Conditioner class name as exposed by the upstream Chroma package (e.g. 'SubstructureConditioner', 'SymmetryConditioner', 'ShapeConditioner', 'ProClassConditioner', 'SubsequenceConditioner'). TODO: replace with a closed enum once upstream freezes the API.

params.description: Free-form kwargs forwarded to the conditioner constructor. Shape depends on `type`.

skip_mpnn.description: If true, the platform will NOT chain ProteinMPNN automatically. Adapter itself always just emits backbones.
